title: M-key mute chain broken: Key.M is never translated to Toggle_Mute, so the executor case is unreachable and mute cannot be toggled
evidence: poll emits the key: app/input/poll.odin:60 — `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.M) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .M})) }`. But mouse_map's two key switches have no .M case. Phase 1 (mouse.odin:77-88): `case .Esc:` / `if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .Esc; keys_n += 1 }` / `case: // R/Enter map via the Game_Over early return; phase-2 keys below`. Phase 2 (mouse.odin:314-344): `#partial switch k.key {` ... `case .E:` `append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_EXPRESS}))` ... `case .B:` `append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_BEST_EFFORT}))` / `case: // phase-1 keys already handled` / `}`. The executor half exists but nothing produces the intent — app/input/exec.odin:44-46: `case Toggle_Mute:` / `// 7.2: the audio mute toggle — app effect (cosmetic; captions stay on).` / `if inp.on_mute != nil { inp.on_mute(inp.user, inp) }`. Repo-wide grep `Toggle_Mute` over *.odin returns only ./app/input/types.odin:147 (struct decl), ./app/input/types.odin:277 (Intent union member), ./app/input/exec.odin:44 (executor case) — zero construction sites; dispatch_frame only runs mouse_map/touch_map/controller_map, and touch/controller have no mute either.
detail: Orchestrator guard: 'M mutes through the intent layer... trace the FULL chain: device poll -> device event -> intent translation -> apply_intent -> on_mute effect -> toggle_mute. Every link must exist.' The intent-translation link is missing, so M does nothing; README's '`M` mutes/unmutes audio' and the PR-body 'Toggle_Mute intent + effect hook' claim are false.
recommended_fix: Add `case .M: append(out, Intent(Toggle_Mute{}))` to mouse_map's phase-2 key switch in app/input/mouse.odin (after the .B lane case), matching the E/S/B app-effect pattern.
